title: Minebloom
description: MineBloom — A fresh Minecraft experience built for community, creativity, and adventure.
body:
Welcome to the MineBloom Discord and Community!
MineBloom is a unique Minecraft: Java and Bedrock Edition (cross-play) server that has been in development for some time now.

We are a dedicated project, created by a carefully-crafted team of individuals who are best at what they do, ensuring a high-quality experience for all players
